451277.overview:
Sumo Slam! is a party game for up to twelve players with sumo wrestlers challenging each other on a platform. The game is played on a fixed-screen showing a platform with the sumo wrestlers using a top-down view. The wrestlers cannot be controlled directly. They constantly rotate in a stationary position at a fixed speed. By pressing and holding down a button the player makes the wrestler go forward in the direction he is facing for as long as the button is pressed. As soon as the button is released the wrestler starts rotating again. The game can be played in different game modes: Sushi (collect sushi playing along against a time limit), Chase (a game of tag) and Fight (bump other wrestlers off the platform). As only a single button or key press is used up to twelve players can participate simultaneously in local multiplayer. When playing alone the computer controls the opponents.
The game is almost identical to the 2004 J2ME title Sumo Smash!, which in turn is based on Jumbo Rumble, but it is not clear how the games are related.

451348.overview: Super Mario World, also known as Super Mario Bros. (超級瑪莉兄弟), is a hack of Squirrel King loosely based on the Super Mario series of platforming games. Both the developers and publishers of the game are Gamtec, and another person gaoing by the name Jazz Dark.  The first two acts are replaced with levels from the original Super Mario Bros. and Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels, with Bowser serving as the boss at the end of each one. Everything else remains the same as Squirrel King, this means elements such as the pipes and blocks in the "Mario" stages do not function at all. The third act starts on Forest Adventure and the fourth act starts on Traverse Red Ravine; with the rest of the acts following in normal order (without repeating Forest Adventure).

451512.overview:
SupraKillminds is a fast-paced puzzle title based on the game Quartet. The goal of the game is to assemble gems by fitting four pieces together. A piece with one of four available colours appears in the middle of the screen. The player has to sent it to one of the four quadrants using the four directions on the D-pad. Based on the form it automatically moves to the correct part of the quadrant. When a complete quadrant is formed, points are scored and the pieces disappear. More points are provided for creating gems completely of the same color, but this is not required. Even if all parts have a different color points are still awarded. When a gem is made and all quadrants are then empty, the largest amount of points is awarded (500) as well as an extra life.
At the start of the game five lives are provided. A life is lost when a piece is accidentally sent to an occupied space or when time runs out before a move is made. Only a small amount of time is available to decide. For every 1,000 points the available time per move is decreased. It starts with two seconds per move.

451543.overview: Super Robot Wars is a Platform Shooter that is a Hackdone by Glorysun of Target Earth Space shooting game set in the future with Earth under attack by robots.  You are the pilot of a mech robot which can either walk on planet surfaces or fly in space.  There are two types of levels in the game.  Surface levels take place on planets or moons and allow the mech to run and jump to the end of the level while fighting enemies, as in a side scrolling game.  Space levels have no gravity and allow the mech to move in any direction.  The mech can be equipped with a large assortment of machine guns, lasers, and grenades.

451922.overview: Academia do Saber (Saber Academy) is a puzzle game. Exclusively released in Brazil on Mega Drive, in the memory of some consoles produced by Tectoy. It has never been produced as a game cartridge. It is a military-themed puzzle game.

453010.overview:
This is a small demo to showcase the bugfixes and options that have gradually accumulated over the last 3 years.

It only features Emerald Hill Zone and Death Egg Zone. I highly reccomend checking out the options menu, thought the default options should lead to a fun experience as well.

This rom hacks' original goal was merely to add time travel into Sonic 2, but it has since evolved into a very customizable experience with influences from Sonic 2, CD, and 3K.

https://shc.zone/entries/expo2021/498

453011.overview:
Sonic 2 Advanced Edit features 7 entirely new zones, each full of unique enemies and with a boss whose gameplay varies depending on which character you play as. Playable characters are Sonic, Tails, Knuckles and Amy. Furthermore as bonus content, the hack features the 5 zones from the 2008 release, brushed up to be fully playable. Upon completing the 7 main zones, you obtain a code to access the level select from which you can play the bonus zones by selecting "South Island 1".

There are 69 big rings scattered throughout the 7 main zones. Collect 7 of them to gain the ability to turn super once you have at least 50 rings in any given level.

Controls:

Sonic, Tails, Knuckles: As in S3K. (No spindash for Tails.)
Amy: A, Down+A: Hammer attacks; B/C, Down+B/C: Jump/Spindash.
Super forms: To enable, hold A+B+C while jumping. (No super form for Tails.)
Level reset: While paused, hold A+B+C to go to start of the level/last starpost (costs 1 life).

Neo South Island: 9

Bamboo Jungle: 10
Blue Mountain: 11
Robotic Ruin: 9

It has been about 10 years in the making, with very little progress in the last few years due to real-life commitments and rika_chou and qiuu as the only remaining contributors. 453017.overview:
Sonic: Scorched Quest (formerly known as Sonic 1: Burned Edition) is a hack created by Team Painto of Sonic the Hedgehog on the Sega Mega Drive, which shows one of Sonic's adventures after the events of Sonic CD on South Island. This hack is also largely recognized by the community after being the multi-trophy winner of the Sonic Hacking Contest 2016.

Shortly after defeating Eggman in Metallic Madness, Sonic decided to head back to South Island. But it seems Eggman has already arrived at the island before him...

In his old base, he studies the hypothetically called "Flame Emeralds", which he have discovered from an alternate dimension. They're seven powerful stones, and can control all types of fire. By then, Eggman decided to built a machine which would let him to open a portal from Green Hill to that dimension to get them all, but... nothing happened. And this angered him a lot, causing himself to destroy his machine due to his fit of rage. However, it seems that in doing this, he accidentally opened the portal, allowing one of the emeralds to come through...

"Mwahaha! Finally I can make my plans reality, and there's no hedgehog to stop me!", said Eggman and returned to Scrap Brain very happy. "Now only to find the rest..."

Sonic then soon lands near home. Everything seems to be fine, but then he hears screams of his animal friends! Knowing who had caused this, he ran once again through Green Hill to check it.

453019.overview:
Sonic ERaZor is a ROM hack of Sonic the Hedgehog created by Selbi. This hack is unlike many others, featuring a (bizarre) in-game story line and ridiculous challenges/mechanics, as well a ton of cutscenes, story screens, and easter eggs. Furthermore, while not originally intended as such, the hack is often summarized as "What if Michael Bay directed Sonic 1?" due to its rampant use of explosions and focus on action.

The name ERaZor, with its upper- and lowercase letters, is a mix of the word eraser and the German word Scherz (meaning "joke" in English). Despite the naming similarities, it has nothing to do with Erazor Djinn or Sonic Eraser.

When first released back in early 2010, Selbi stated that this hack had no goal whatsoever, and any ideas he came up with just went in. Today's releases have a lot more structure and thought-out gameplay elements. The difficulty has been steadily balanced with each new release, mostly due to negative feedback regarding the frustrating game design of the earlier ones. However, it deliberately remains tough and has never abandoned its roots as a difficult game.

In 2024, the hack received its first update in over eight years with the release of the Seventh Public Release, which introduced Casual/Frantic Mode (a unique difficulty selection specifically built around ERaZor's identity).

453020.overview:
Venture through time!

The evil Dr. Robotnik has been meddling with time itself! In order to stop him and prevent a bad future for South Island, Sonic must travel through time and stop the Doctor's evil schemes!

Featuring 9 acts filled with exploration, platforming, and speed, take control of Sonic to put an end to Dr. Robotnik's plot!

Controls:

A, B, C = Jump

A, B, C (During Spring animation) = Air Curl

Options:

The options menu contains several different color palettes you can use for Sonic, as well as an option to disable Sonic CD's extended camera. The spindash and peelout are unavaliable for this build, as the option does not work properly yet.

Red Hot: Sonic with red fur instead of blue.
Tides: Based on Ecco's palette from Ecco: The Tides of Time
Cringe: Based on Sonic's palette from Sonic Mania.
Darker: Based on the colors of Shadow the Hedgehog.

453021.overview:
A recent binge of almost every 2D Metroid game and pure boredom resulted in me creating this hack. It's basically just a proof of concept at the moment, I do plan on recreating the entire NES Metroid map in the style of Sonic eventually but I have a few other projects I'm working on, and if I ever learn how to work with Sonic 1's bosses I'd include Ridley, Kraid, and Mother Brain.

Player's Guide:

Your goal is to get to the switch at the entrance to Tourian, and to do that you need to scour the map for powerups.

Only Brinstar, Kraid's lair, and Tourian can be explored in this build, but I do plan to have other areas in future releases.

Items:

Morph Ball - Allows Sonic to roll by pressing the down button.

Spindash - Allows Sonic to spindash by holding down and pressing jump.

Speed Booster - Lets Sonic use the Peelout by holding up and pressing jump. Doesn't yet grant invincibility.

Energy Tank - Gives 10 rings. (I don't have the skills to overhaul the health system to be more like Metroid)

Spring Ball - Increases Sonic's jump height (doesn't work underwater yet).

Varia - Grants sonic immunity from lava. (Doesn't function properly when sonic takes damage so you won't lose rings when being hit)

Gravity - Makes Sonic immune from water physics (jump height is not affected at the moment) and lava.

KNOWN ISSUES:

Collision is janky because of the NES metroid art. Future releases will have this fixed by having new art.

Upon getting a game over, Sonic's powerups don't reset.

453270.overview:
Welcome to Sonic 2 VS, a multiplayer-focused ROM hack of the original Sonic the Hedgehog 2 for the Mega Drive!

The focus of this ROM hack is everything 2-player mode. We have majorly overhauled the entire thing to optimise it for your enjoyment and playing experience, and now all zones from Emerald Hill through to Metropolis are available to play. Customise how you want your versus experience to be, with the ability to choose how many zones to play in a round, how the scoring of each level works, and even specific item priorities.

Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles are all available to play as. Both players can even select the same character! All three have their signature moves, with Sonic able to use Mania's drop dash, Tails can fly and swim, and Knuckles can glide and climb. You can also choose between multiple palettes available for each character to customise to your own preferences.

The Special Stages have been completely rewritten to offer a much smoother, graphically-enhanced experience, making them feel a lot more like the RSDK remakes and to show just what the Mega Drive is actually capable of. Find a starpost during your versus experience and play in a variety of 1-section Bonus Stages to gain or lose rings on your opponent before returning to normal play. There are a significant number of new tie breaker Special Stages added as well, be sure to check them out!

Try out the new Super VS Battle, where both characters are instantly in their super form and have to not only hunt down the other player from a random starting point in the level but battle each other until they run out of rings and make the other perish.

And while the focus isn't specifically on it, the single player experience has had various enhancements as well. Try it out to find everything that's been improved on the original!

A lot more has been done than just that listed here, and there is a lot more to come, so grab a friend and enjoy Sonic 2 VS!

453886.overview:
After sonic forces, Dr Eggman destroys Green Hill zone to Lure sonic and his friends into a trap.

454402.overview:
Sonic The Hedgehog 2 Archives is another beta hack that seeks to bring back cut content from the game's Prototypes, revitalize the game's concept and release levels and badniks, and fully recreate the early concept of the time-travel story. Along with this hack improves both the prototype content and the final content by adding new animations, badnik and character shots, level art and backgrounds, new music, and more.

Sonic the Hedgehog - the fastest hedgehog on Earth, arrives on Westside Island to relax, but Dr. Ivo "Eggman" Robotnik is already raging on the Westside island. Here Sonic meets Miles "Tails" Prower, a two-tailed fox who is well versed in technology and also knows how to fly. This time, Eggman has conceived something more, and, having heard of the rumors of time travel centred around an ancient temple, plans to use time itself to aid in his plans!

A new adventure awaits for Sonic and Tails, as they chase Eggman through time to stop his plans to take over the future!

454547.overview:
This hack is for fans to play for usual characters from the SOR universe.

The hack is primarily inspired by these two works: SOR2 - ULTRA 2018 and SOR2 - The Return of the Fighters 2019.

This hack allows the player to play as the modified versions Max, SOR3 versions of Axel, Blaze and Roo in SOR2.

II. Features:

    Axel and Blaze have SOR3 style appearances with some modifications.
    All playable characters can run (with weapon animations).
    All playable characters can change direction and turn around while running.
    All playable characters can jump further while running.
    The command to run (f, f) becomes more sensitive.
    The game has Juggling. I mean JUGGLING!!
    Neutral Air Attack(Jump+B) is now Air to Air. Works great for juggling an opponent in a corner or while playing in Co-op, but can miss when attacking a ground target.
    You can choose the same characters.
    SoR3 like combo style - you can deal full combo, without hit enemy.
    Player characters have animation recovery when they escape from being thrown (up + C).
    Charge attacks require holding B for only 2/3 second.
    Offensive Special no longer costs player’s own health.
    If the player presses A while running, the player’s character will perform Offensive Special (in the original game, nothing will happen).
    You can use the Defensive Special and Offensive Special when you capture the enemy.
    You can use the Defensive Special and Offensive Special when grabbing an enemy from behind.
    KO count of the players is displayed.
    Roo replaces Skate as a playable character.
    Mania difficulty is directly accessible.
    Stage selection is available.

III. Characters:

Max:

    Max has the fewest changes, the new dynamics will boost it incredibly.
    Used Pile driver patch (but replaced the sprite with a more suitable one)
    You can move a little while using Defensive Special.

Axel:

    Jump Down + B: Tatsumaki.
    New Grab Combo.
    New FFB. Spin to Win!
    FA now is “Shoryuken” You can destroyed Jet.

Blaze:

    Used color scheme from this hack.
    New, custom B + C attack;
    B + C. The sprite is drawn by savok.
    B + C new special effect taken from this rom.
    Jump Down + B: Terra Shield.
    New FFB.

ROO:

    The best representative of the Hunter family!
    Used some new sprites from SORRemake.
    New Throw Animation.
    New grab combo.
    Roo can now use the “headbat” immediately, when capturing, the neutral attack button.
    Jump DB: “Tatsumaki”

IV. Hint:

If you did a Forward Jump Attack with a run, and continue to hold forward, then upon landing the character will run further. You can use this to apply the new B + C Blaze attack.

454917.overview: Han Solo and Chewbacca are racing to the Kashyyyk planet to celebrate the Life Day with their family and friends. 455112.overview: It's a ROM hack where the main gimmick transforms and speeds through South Island before your ring counter runs out. Destroy everything in your path, collide with anything you bump into and try to get hurt. The only thing that'll damage you is time; you better not waste that. Every ring counts so try and collect them as fast as you can! Even though this is a challenge-based hack, you will find that this hack will have more than just a simple concept.

457666.overview:
Shaolin Carcará is a homebrew beat-’em-up developed by Manganga Team for the Sega Mega Drive. Created by indie enthusiasts, it’s a passion project that blends old-school gameplay with distinct visual charm.

Gameplay follows a classic side-scrolling format, with players taking on waves of enemies using punches, kicks, and special moves. The action unfolds across varied stages, from eerie cemeteries to misty mountain peaks. Combat is simple but satisfying, supported by vibrant pixel art and a catchy soundtrack. While the experience is short and enemy variety limited, it’s a solid pick for fans of quick arcade-style action.

459501.overview:
If you’re a fan of Sonic 2 and like that game the most in the series, then this Sonic The Hedgehog 2 – Anniversary Edition by Sophiedude is your Sonic Euphoria.

This hack/patch of Sonic 2 is jam packed with many customisable options tailor-made to suit every gamer’s needs and wants plus improved graphics done to the colour palette and sprites as well as an enormous selection of music in the sound test with a complete remixed soundtrack of Sonic 2.

FEATURES:

* Amy Rose as a playable character in V4 complete with a modified version of her Sonic Advance Move set.
* Hard mode added with more rings removed and more Badniks and Spikes.
* Eggman has dialogue when you defeat him.
* Easy/Hard Mode available.
* Hill Top Zone is playable in 2P Mode. Highlight Emerald Hill and Hold C and Push Start.
* Brand new remixed soundtrack with the original soundtrack also available.
* The Game Gear and Master System Sonic 2 Soundtrack has been added.
* Cyber City and Hidden Palace are playable. Cyber City needs to be turned on in the Options Menu.
* In a 1P Sonic & Tails game, you can choose whether you want Tails to hit the boss or not.
* There is an air speed cap that can be turned on or off.
* Tails can now fly.
* You can choose to skip Metropolis Zone.
* You can choose what boss music you want for the Silver Sonic boss.
* Each act have been given its own palette and soundtrack.
* Uses Clownacy’s awesome SMPS Cloned V2 sound driver in 68k.
* Drums and samples are super clear!
* Works on real hardware via an EverDrive.
CheckSum is fixed.

2 new features in the Options Menu have been added.
* Amy Can Roll – This option allows Amy to roll like everyone else – in case you wish Amy could roll.
* Roll Jump Lock – Normally, when you jump from a rolling state, you cannot move Sonic. if this option is turned on, you can control Sonic just like in Sonic CD or Mania.

459514.overview:
To celebrate 30 years of Sonic, here's an Enhanced Version of the very first game.

Features:

* Enchanced graphics
* Remix music, with the original available as an option
* Tails and Knuckles are playable
* Brand New Easy and Hard mode, That remixes the Levels and makes them easier or harder
* Tons of bugfixes, too many for me to list, Just know the game has been optimized
* The Spindash has been added
* Sonic is now a more bluer shade of blue
* Act 2 and 3 of each Zone have been given a new look and their own song.
* New Routes for Tails and Knuckles have been added, based the on mobile version, with one new one in SYZ Act 3 for Knuckles
* Eggman has full set of voice clips and you can even have Mike Pollock or as Chikao Otsuka based on whether you're playing on a USA/European Genesis/Mega Drive or a Japanese Mega Drive
* Brand new Goggle powerup the is exclusive to easy mode, the Goggles allows Sonic to breath underwater but he loses them if he loses rings, By the way the Goggles are not very common.
* Eggman monitors now works and are exclusive to Hard mode
* The Japanese Credit and Sound test Ending cheats are now Accessible on any Genesis/Mega Drive not just the Japanese Mega Drive
* A new cheat has been added that swaps the region of the console your playing on, on the title screen press Up, Down, Down, Down, Up
* The GHZ and SYZ bosses are the only bosses affected by Hard mode at the moment
* The Sonic 3 object manager has been added in, which will reduce slowdown
* The Removed badnik Splats has been readded, you can find him in Marble Zone's Easy and Hard mode
* The Removed GHZ rolling ball has been Readded, you can find it in Debug Mode in GHZ, As I couldn't find a good use for it
* All names in the credits have been changed to everyone's real name, expect for Papa as I couldn't find who that is.
* The Special Stages rotates a lot smoother
* The Special Stage is also unaffected by Easy or Hard mode, Not sure how you make it easier or Harder it since it just an odd Special Stage
* There is now an actual Jump Height in the Special Stage, Sonic will now jump higher or lower depending on how long you press the button
* A new sound effect has been added for the Down block and the R Block in the Special Stages, so they don't share the same sound as the Up block

There is a Brand New Options menu which includes:
* Character - Change which Character you are playing
* Difficulty - Change which Difficulty you want to play
* Spindash - Set whether you want the Spindash on or off for pure Sonic 1.

459540.overview:

From the creators of Sonic 2 Co-op from SHC 2023, we've taken your feedback to heart and crafted a completely new multiplayer Sonic 1 ROM hack to the best of our abilities.

462278.overview:
In late 2023, RobiWanKenobi started a Sonic 2 hack with no real goals in mind except to try to make levels. This came after his hack, Sonic Primo was what could be considered, a huge failure; this stems from him over-hyping the project while not managing a quality release.

The hack started as just plain modifications to Sonic 2 zones, after having ported over a bunch of Sonic 3 stuff and release a build to the Sonic Hacking Contest's Level Design Mini-Contest (which had some broken physics, but some otherwise good ideas). After that, he then found the to-be-level-artist Bonnie Bun-Buns; who was making some data select icons for some zone ideas he had. RobiWanKenobi contacted him, and asked if he could make some full-on level art of some of these zone; he said yes.

RobiWanKenobi, MarioFan30 (then known as h.carrell), Hame, and Bonnie Bun-Buns would form the original Revenge Team, with few new members coming in. Over time, the user Toilet Man (now known as Audrey) joined and did the majority of the work to port Blue Spheres over from Sonic 3, before leaving the team in 2025. TomatoWave_0 was briefly a play-tester for S:PR, before leaving to focus on other hacks; HenryD3bby was also on the team for a while before leaving the scene almost entirely.

After The 2024 Sonic Hacking Contest, RobiWanKenobi decided to polish up some old work from Bonnie Bun-Buns to make the new Sonic sprites, after realizing how many hacks had the CartoonAnimates22 Sonic & Tails sprites; RobiWanKenobi then made the Tails sprites, based off of Sonic 3. ToastOnBread would then join as the musician for the game, as the music written by RobiWanKenobi before was not really good.

462280.overview:

464822.overview: Sleigh Chase is a Christmas minigame for Sega Mega Drive/Genesis

465007.overview:

* Unpromoted level cap is 20, promoted level cap is 40
* The REPAIR option has been replaced with TRAIN
* AGI affects evasion
* ATK influences the damage of spells
* ATLAS is now thunder elemental
* DESOUL has a 50% chance of hitting, but only reduces the enemy’s HP by half their current amount.

Both Spider-Man and the enemies themselves are invincible. For actions under the Control Pad, A throws web balls when Spider-Man is not moving, B does a punch (or a kick while moving or crouched) and C jumps (it is also possible to climb certain wooden boxes by pressing C again and using the D button to move around);  START  pauses the game as usual. Health bar, score counter, time and a photograph camera were also added as mechanics, but they are not functional (the score counter works to display coordinates of Spider-Man).

It is unknown if Spider-Man was just meant to be a technical demonstration or if was about to be turned into a full game, though for the latter, Sega Enterprises managed to get a license from Marvel Entertainment than Tengen, of which the final game became Spider-Man vs. The Kingpin.

The demo's source code was restored from a hard disk drive lot from Tengen and compiled into ROM format by Video Game History Foundation in December 2025.

473491.overview:
Space Harrier II is a new, updated version of the game created by M2 and included on the Genesis Mini 2.

The original Space Harrier II was created as a launch title for the Sega Genesis, and it recieved mostly middling reviews, both at the time of release and today. Most reviewers made negative comparrions between Space Harrier II and its predecessor, the superior Space Harrier arcade game, and they were especially critical about Space Harrier II's visuals. However Space Harrier was one of the most expensive and technically advanced arcade cabinets of 1985, and even at the time of the Genesis's release three years later, a home console couldn't really be expected to compete with it.

For their remake of Space Harrier II, M2 imagined what the game could have been if the Genesis was a more powerful system. M2 created a virtual console they named the Sega Mark V, which is a technologically enhanced version of the Genesis that could have been released by Sega with the technology that was available in 1988. The Sega Mark V has additional sprite scaling capabilities, but it retains most of the original Genesis hardware limitations, including its sprite limits.

M2's new version of Space Harrier II was rebuilt from scratch for the Mark V virtual console, and it looks, and plays, much better than the original Sega version. However, because of the Genesis's sprite limitations, it has a lot of flicker. There's a hidden option to remove the flicker, but this comes at a cost in other areas.

It was a pay to play service, through which customers could access Genesis games online, play game demos, and get cheat codes. Lasting until July 31, 1998, the Sega Channel operated three years after the release of Sega's next generation console, the Sega Saturn. Though criticized for its poorly timed launch and costly subscription fee, the Sega Channel has been praised for its innovations in downloadable content and impact on online game services.

Many homebrew versions of the Sega Channel have existed online, including recreations of what the service looked like and demos of games that appeared on the channel over its lifetime.
